name: Julia Brim-Edwards

bio.statement: Brim-Edwards currently serves as Multnomah County's District 3 Commissioner.
In her voters' pamphlet statement, Brim-Edwards lists her occupational background as a Nike senior director and small business owner.
bio.excerpt: Senior Director, Nike; Small business owner

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026, large print)

collection_notes: The SOS Book 13 (Multnomah edition) PDF text is cut off by the fetch tool at ~120k characters (page 49), before the judicial and county sections; the county's large-print Multnomah pamphlet (pages 42-43 for Chair) was used instead. The fetch tool limits quotes to ~125 characters, so some excerpts are fragments. Brim-Edwards is the sitting District 3 Commissioner (multco.us/board) but not the incumbent Chair, so incumbent=false for this race. Campaign domain JuliaBrim-Edwards.com is printed in her pamphlet statement. Candidate filing PDF had no machine-readable text. OPB item p8 excerpt is a quote from her campaign announcement as reported by OPB.
